import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem quadratic_sublevel_radius_iff_abs_centered (x r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) : x ^ 2 - 5 * x - 4 ≤ (r ^ 2 - 41) / 4 ↔ |2 * x - 5| ≤ r := by
  have hsq_abs : |2 * x - 5| ^ 2 = (2 * x - 5) ^ 2 := by
    simpa using (sq_abs (2 * x - 5))
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hsq : (2 * x - 5) ^ 2 ≤ r ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 * x - 5)]
    have habs_sq : |2 * x - 5| ^ 2 ≤ r ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [hsq, hsq_abs]
    by_contra hnot
    have hgt : r < |2 * x - 5| := lt_of_not_ge hnot
    have hsum : 0 < |2 * x - 5| + r := by
      nlinarith [abs_nonneg (2 * x - 5)]
    have hprod :
        0 < (|2 * x - 5| - r) * (|2 * x - 5| + r) := by
      exact mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hgt) hsum
    nlinarith [habs_sq, hprod]
  · intro h
    have hleft : 0 ≤ r - |2 * x - 5| := sub_nonneg.mpr h
    have hright : 0 ≤ r + |2 * x - 5| := by
      nlinarith [abs_nonneg (2 * x - 5)]
    have hprod :
        0 ≤ (r - |2 * x - 5|) * (r + |2 * x - 5|) :=
      mul_nonneg hleft hright
    have hsq : (2 * x - 5) ^ 2 ≤ r ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [hprod, hsq_abs]
    nlinarith [hsq]

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem quadratic_sublevel_radius_iff_abs_centered (x r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) : x ^ 2 - 5 * x - 4 ≤ (r ^ 2 - 41) / 4 ↔ |2 * x - 5| ≤ r := by
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hs : (2 * x - 5) ^ 2 ≤ r ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [h]
    constructor
    · by_contra hn
      have hlt : 2 * x - 5 < -r := lt_of_not_ge hn
      have h₁ : 2 * x - 5 + r < 0 := by
        linarith
      have h₂ : 2 * x - 5 - r < 0 := by
        linarith
      have hp : 0 < (2 * x - 5 + r) * (2 * x - 5 - r) :=
        mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg h₁ h₂
      nlinarith [hs, hp]
    · by_contra hn
      have hlt : r < 2 * x - 5 := lt_of_not_ge hn
      have h₁ : 0 < 2 * x - 5 - r := by
        linarith
      have h₂ : 0 < 2 * x - 5 + r := by
        linarith
      have hp : 0 < (2 * x - 5 - r) * (2 * x - 5 + r) :=
        mul_pos h₁ h₂
      nlinarith [hs, hp]
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    have h₃ : 0 ≤ 2 * x - 5 + r := by
      linarith
    have h₄ : 0 ≤ r - (2 * x - 5) := by
      linarith
    have hp : 0 ≤ (2 * x - 5 + r) * (r - (2 * x - 5)) :=
      mul_nonneg h₃ h₄
    nlinarith [hp]
